name: Click Window Macro
description: Record a macro of a level, then replay it only when you click within a few frames of each recorded click.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Off: nothing happens. Record: records your clicks, saved when you complete the level. Replay: the macro only clicks when you click within the window of a recorded click.

window.name: Click window (steps)
window.description: How many physics steps early or late your click can be and still trigger the macro's click.
